Implementation Plan

## Implementation plan: canary-b redo (issue under tracking #7397)

Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-7397` @ `2b7eab2b525d161414d01fb47c97efdc06ae1f15`. The integration branch matches, so the mismatch check is `false`.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue asks for one change to one line of an existing file and forbids edits to any other file. Nothing needs to be widened or narrowed. No new code, helpers or patterns are involved.

This plan does not add a new script, extend a script, or change any scheduler wiring. It does not add a supervisor, does no database work, and adds no entry to the removal registry.

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt`

## Functions or modules to implement
None. This is a data-file edit: line 2 changes from `decompose-run: 25567947079` to `decompose-run: 38660755875`. Line 1 (`status: ok`) stays as it is.

## Data structures affected
The two-line canary text file only.

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — Edit only line 2
- Chosen: Replace line 2 with `decompose-run: 38660755875` and leave line 1 byte-identical.
- Alternatives considered: Rewriting the whole file; adding a changelog fragment.
- Why: The issue says "Do not edit any other file", and `files_touched` lists only this file. A changelog fragment would break that scope.

## Security considerations
- No trust boundaries, endpoints, credentials or money state are touched.
- The run ID comes from the trusted orchestrator metadata in the issue body. It is a literal value and is never executed.

## Risks and edge cases
- Keep the existing trailing-newline convention so `sed -n 2p` prints exactly the required line with no stray CR.
- The previous attempt (#7399) closed without a merged PR. The implementer must make sure the edit is committed so the PR is not an empty no-op.

## Testing considerations
- `sed -n 1p tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt` → `status: ok`
- `sed -n 2p tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt` → `decompose-run: 38660755875`
- `git diff --stat` should show only this file.

## Pre-execution self-check
- Requirements map to a single file, as the issue requires.
- No clarification questions are needed.
